scientific_integrity: The lattice-point equivalence is explicitly attributed to the 2022 source; the new statement is the exact Euclidean diameter pair and its nonzero limiting difference. Symbolic inequality and all-pairs distance certificates are included.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicit consecutive-length chainlink family and the two complementary integer heights, with m>=3, are classified. No assertion on arbitrary chainlinks, independence of publication, or external proof certification.
title: A persistent Euclidean diameter gap in Ehrhart-equivalent chainlink sections
